name: Лемминговый сок
alt: Три крошечных лемминга маршируют к стаканчику рядом с флаконом.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, legible at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms, strong readable silhouette. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery and one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear structure and anatomy, no unintended extra parts. Subject: One pear-shaped glass potion bottle filled with vivid orange liquid, corked, sitting beside a tiny empty wooden drinking cup. Exactly three tiny round tan lemmings with cream bellies, small ears, four short paws each and stub tails march single file around the bottle toward the cup, absurdly determined expressions. They are alive and cheerful, no harm or cliffs, simple readable silhouettes, no fruit labels or text, warm orange and brown palette.
